name: Cloudflare
label: Cloudflare API
description: Cloudflare API v4 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/. Operations: dns_list, dns_create, dns_update, dns_delete, zone_get, cache_purge, worker_list, r2_get, cert_get, cert_upload, listen. Auth secret api_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: dns_list | dns_create | dns_update | dns_delete | zone_get | cache_purge | worker_list | r2_get | cert_get | cert_upload | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'dns_list'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: DNS record id.

schema.label: bucket
schema.description: R2 bucket.

schema.label: key
schema.description: R2 object key. File payloads use type file.

schema.label: certificate
schema.description: PEM certificate chain for cert_upload (body certificate). Paste the full -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- text, leaf first. Required for cert_upload. Example: -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- MIID... -----END CERTIFICATE-----.

schema.label: name
schema.description: DNS record name for dns_list (filter), dns_create and dns_update (required). Use the full name or @ for the zone apex. Example: www.example.com.

schema.label: type
schema.description: DNS record type for dns_list (filter), dns_create and dns_update (required). EXACT common: A | AAAA | CNAME | MX | TXT | NS | SRV | CAA. Example: A.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operation: dns_list.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operation: dns_list.

schema.label: content
schema.description: DNS record value for dns_create / dns_update: IPv4 for A, IPv6 for AAAA, target host for CNAME, text for TXT. Example: 198.51.100.4.

schema.label: ttl
schema.description: Record TTL in seconds for dns_create / dns_update. 1 means automatic (the default when empty); otherwise 30-86400. Example: 3600.

schema.label: proxied
schema.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare for dns_create / dns_update. true | false. Only A, AAAA and CNAME records can be proxied. Example: true.

schema.label: purge_everything
schema.description: cache_purge: true purges every cached file in the zone. Use instead of files / tags / hosts / prefixes. Example: true.

schema.label: files
schema.description: cache_purge: list of full URLs to purge. Example: ["https://www.example.com/css/app.css"].

schema.label: tags
schema.description: cache_purge: list of Cache-Tag values to purge. Example: ["product-123","homepage"].

schema.label: hosts
schema.description: cache_purge: list of hostnames whose cached files are purged. Example: ["www.example.com"].

schema.label: prefixes
schema.description: cache_purge: list of URL prefixes (host + path, no scheme) to purge. Example: ["www.example.com/images"].

schema.label: private_key
schema.description: PEM private key for cert_upload (body private_key) matching certificate. Required for cert_upload. Treat as sensitive: wire it from a secret source, never hard-code it. Example: -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- MIIE... -----END PRIVATE KEY-----.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: dns_list, dns_create, dns_update, dns_delete, zone_get, cache_purge, worker_list, r2_get, cert_get, cert_upload, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Cloudflare API token (preferred). Do not use the Global API Key.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Cloudflare Webhook Secret
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header cf-webhook-auth. Never logged.
